description: Parse textual network-configuration files and report, per network, the bind/gateway addresses split into IPv4 and IPv6 families, ordered by network name. Exercises boundary inputs: an empty configuration set, a network that binds only addresses of a single family, multiple networks whose emitted order must follow the network name ordering, a configuration mixing a well-formed network with a malformed one (the malformed network is skipped without aborting the whole parse), and a network whose first line carries both interleaved dual-family bind addresses and a trailing network-level resolver token that must not leak into the bind output.

cases.expected_output:
network=alpha
bind_v4=10.6.0.1
bind_v6=
network=zeta
bind_v4=10.5.0.1
bind_v6=
